name: Quy Nhon
provinceNote: The city is still described as the center of Bình Định.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: A coastal city known for Ky Co, Eo Gio, a long city beach, Cham towers, and seafood. Swim the yellow crescent in the center, take the day across Thi Nai to Ky Co and Eo Gio, see the Cham twin towers, and eat bun cha ca and the catch on Xuan Dieu.
timeNeeded: A night on the crescent, plus a day on Phuong Mai or the south coast
fee: No single city ticket. The city beach and Ghềnh Ráng are free. Eo Gió is 25,000 đồng, children under 0.9 m free. Tháp Đôi is 20,000 đồng. Tháp Bánh Ít and the Quang Trung museum are 15,000 đồng each. Kỳ Co is listed at 30,000–60,000 đồng, and Cù Lao Xanh at 200,000–350,000 đồng. What those ranges buy: Check on arrival. Trung Lương is listed as free and as 40,000 đồng including a shower. Bãi Xếp, horse-cart fares, and stall prices: Check on arrival.
getThere: Phù Cát airport, or Diêu Trì on the north–south railway. Da Nang is 300 km by the coast road. Ho Chi Minh City is 686 km. Hanoi is 1,065 km.
seoTitle: Quy Nhon travel guide — Ky Co, Eo Gio, city beach, Cham towers, seafood
seoDescription: Swim the city beach, cross to Ky Co and Eo Gio, see the Cham twin towers, and eat seafood on Xuan Dieu. Da Nang is 300 km up the coast.
intro: Quy Nhon is Ky Co and Eo Gio, a long city beach, the Cham twin towers, and seafood on Xuân Diệu after dark. You wake on a crescent of yellow sand, fairly clear and blue, with the buildings along Xuân Diệu a short walk from the water. Stay here when that night, and the day across Thị Nại, are the trip. Go to Da Nang, 300 km up the coast, when that city is the trip, or continue south toward Nha Trang.

The city beach is free, open 6:00–23:00, with a visit field of 60 minutes. A beach day is longer than that field. Ky Co is the closed cove nearly 25 km out, hills on three sides, and Eo Gio is the rock saddle on the same peninsula day.

Evening is Xuân Diệu, for seafood and a cafe on the sand, then Quảng trường Nguyễn Tất Thành, 6.5 ha on the avenue of that name. The square is free and open 6:00–22:00. Horse carts leave from Xuân Diệu near the square, along Xuân Diệu or An Dương Vương. The square holds New Year fireworks and Festival võ Bình Định.

Cầu Thị Nại is the span on the road toward the peninsula. It is called the longest sea bridge, and it is also given as 2,477.3 m and 54 spans, on a road of more than 7 km that also has five shorter bridges. The photograph is the span by day. The lamps are the bridge after dark. The lagoon is 8 km northeast. A 7:00–18:00 line is not a gate that closes the road.

A day across the bridge is Phương Mai. Eo Gió is the rock saddle: 25,000 đồng, children under 0.9 m free, open 7:00–19:00. Photographers have called the sunset the finest in Vietnam, and a 24 Feb 2021 account calls the sunrise the finest. The calm window is lunar month 3 through the end of lunar month 9. Stay away when the sea is rough. Kỳ Co is listed at 30,000–60,000 đồng. Read the board before you pay. That range is separate from Eo Gió’s 25,000 đồng.

South of the center, Ghềnh Ráng is about 3 km and free: egg-shaped stones, and the cove called bãi tắm Hoàng Hậu because Nam Phương Hoàng Hậu bathed there. Bãi Xếp is 13 km south on the Quy Nhơn–Sông Cầu road. Inside the city, Tháp Đôi is the late-12th-century Cham pair, 20,000 đồng, 7:00–18:00. It is listed in Phường Quy Nhơn and in phường Đống Đa. Tháp Bánh Ít, about 20 km away, is a different site.
gettingAround: The city beach is a walk from the center. Sleep on the crescent if that night is the trip. Quy Hòa and Bãi Xếp, 13 km south, are the quieter sand. Lodging there runs from homestay to resort.
Phù Cát is the airport. A flight to Hồ Chí Minh City takes 1 hour and a flight to Hà Nội takes 2 hours.

Ga Diêu Trì is the north–south stop. Ga Quy Nhơn is not on that standing table. Southbound SE7 is Đà Nẵng 22:30 and Diêu Trì 04:12 the next day. Northbound SE8 is Sài Gòn 06:00 and Diêu Trì 18:07. Those clocks sit on a timetable that still carries a 2014 label and no later revision date. Extra trains SE30 and SE29 stopped at both Diêu Trì and Quy Nhơn in February and March 2025 only.
The coast road is 300 km to Đà Nẵng, 686 km to Hồ Chí Minh City, and 1,065 km from Hà Nội. Kỳ Co is nearly 25 km, road and boat as one figure. Hải Minh is about 15 minutes by boat from bến Hàm Tử.

stayAreas.name: The crescent
stayAreas.summary: Beachfront rooms along the yellow sand, a walk from the swim and from Xuân Diệu after dark. Quy Hòa and Bãi Xếp, 13 km south, are the quieter alternative.

eat: Order bún chả cá on Nguyễn Huệ. The broth is simmered from fish bones, often tuna or sailfish, not pork bone, and the cakes are both fried and steamed. One account leaves the dill out. Another adds chopped scallion and dill. Dip the cake in chili sauce and pickled shallot, and put the herbs in the bowl.

Bánh xèo tôm nhảy is the thin yellow cake. The shrimp are small and turn red, with bean sprouts and scallion. Wrap it with sprouts, cucumber, and star fruit, and eat it with fish sauce. One account calls them freshwater shrimp. Another calls them brackish tôm đất from the Thị Nại lagoon. The cake is on Diên Hồng and Đống Đa, and the menu also includes squid, beef, and egg.

Bún nem is noodles with nem chua, grilled fish cake, herbs, peanut, pickled mustard, and coriander, in a sour-hot-salty-sweet sauce that changes by shop, in the center. Bánh mì lagu is a thick soup with a large piece of pork, eaten with bread, from a lane off Nguyễn Huệ.

Bánh hỏi is a morning plate from Diêu Trì, and bánh ít lá gai is the cone-shaped cake. Bún Song Thằn belongs to An Nhơn, nem chợ huyện to Tuy Phước, and bánh tráng nước dừa to Tam Quan. Bánh bèo is on Nguyễn Tất Thành nối dài, Nguyễn Thái Học, and Mai Xuân Thưởng.
interestsBody: Eat bún chả cá on Nguyễn Huệ, the shrimp pancake on Diên Hồng, and seafood on Xuân Diệu.
The city crescent is the swim in the center. Kỳ Co and Eo Gió are the day across Thị Nại.
Photographers have called the Eo Gió sunset the finest in Vietnam, and a 24 Feb 2021 account calls the sunrise the finest.
Tháp Đôi is the Cham pair inside the city. The museum on Nguyễn Huệ keeps the Cham room: five rooms, free, open 7:00–17:00.
The white span is the day picture of Thị Nại. The lamps are the bridge after dark.
Ghềnh Ráng is the egg-stone cove about 3 km south of the center. Bãi Xếp is 13 km on.
Chợ Đêm sells clothes, shoes, and souvenirs.

interestGroups.title: The city crescent
interestGroups.summary: The yellow sand in the center, a walk from the rooms along Xuân Diệu.
body: Bãi biển Quy Nhơn is a long crescent of yellow sand with water that is fairly clear and blue, in Phường Quy Nhơn. The swim is free, and the open field is 6:00–23:00.
Quảng trường Nguyễn Tất Thành is 6.5 ha on the avenue of that name, free, open 6:00–22:00. The crescent in the photograph is the beach by day.

cards.title: City beach
cards.summary: The long yellow crescent in the center, a walk from the rooms on Xuân Diệu.

interestGroups.title: Phuong Mai for the day
interestGroups.summary: Eo Gió’s rock saddle and Kỳ Co’s closed crescent, the day across Thị Nại.
body: Eo Gió is a curved gap between two rock ridges. The fee is 25,000 đồng, and children under 0.9 m are free. The open field is 7:00–19:00. The calm season is lunar month 3 through the end of lunar month 9. Stay away when the sea is rough.

Photographers have called the Eo Gió sunset the finest in Vietnam. A 24 Feb 2021 account calls the sunrise the finest. Kỳ Co is listed at 30,000–60,000 đồng. Read the board before you pay. It is listed in Phường Quy Nhơn Đông and in xã Nhơn Lý.

cards.title: Eo Gio
cards.summary: Stand in the rock saddle and look down at the sea. The fee is 25,000 đồng.

cards.title: Ky Co
cards.summary: A crescent with hills on three sides, nearly 25 km out. Read the price board before you pay.

interestGroups.title: Twin towers and the Cham room
interestGroups.summary: Tháp Đôi inside the city, and the Cham room at the museum on Nguyễn Huệ.
body: Tháp Đôi, also Tháp Hưng Thạnh, is a pair of late-12th-century Cham towers: a square body and a curved top, Garuda at the corners, ranked an architecture-and-art relic in 1980. The fee is 20,000 đồng. The open field is 7:00–18:00. The visit field is 120 minutes. It is listed in Phường Quy Nhơn and in phường Đống Đa.

Bảo tàng tổng hợp Bình Định is at 26 Nguyễn Huệ. It is free, open 7:00–17:00, and holds five rooms, including a Cham room, plus sculpture in the yard. Tháp Bánh Ít is about 20 km away and is not this visit.

cards.title: Twin towers
cards.summary: Both Cham towers, inside the city. The fee is 20,000 đồng.

interestGroups.title: The bridge after dark
interestGroups.summary: The white span across the lagoon. The photograph shows the bridge by day.
body: Afternoon light and the lamps after dark are the bridge. It is called the longest sea bridge, and it is also given as 2,477.3 m, 54 spans, on a road of more than 7 km. Crossing is free. The 7:00–18:00 field is not a gate that closes the road. The lagoon is 8 km northeast.
The photograph is the full span by day, with mangrove and water. The lamps are the bridge after dark.

cards.title: Thi Nai bridge
cards.summary: The span by day. After dark, the lamps.

interestGroups.title: Queen’s cove
interestGroups.summary: Ghềnh Ráng’s egg stones, about 3 km southeast of the center.
body: Egg-shaped stones the sea has rounded line the cove called bãi tắm Hoàng Hậu, because Nam Phương Hoàng Hậu bathed here. The same shore has a Vọng Phu rock, a lion-shaped rock, bãi tắm Tiên Sa, and Hàn Mặc Tử’s grave on the hillside. Bảo Đại chose Ghềnh Ráng as a royal retreat from 1927. The visit is free, open 7:00–18:00, about 3 km southeast.
Bãi Xếp is 13 km south on quốc lộ 1D, two crescent beaches in a fishing village.

cards.title: Ghenh Rang
cards.summary: Walk the egg stones and the cove named for Nam Phương Hoàng Hậu.

faqs.q: Should you stay in Quy Nhon or Da Nang?
faqs.a: Stay here when Ky Co, Eo Gio, the crescent, and seafood on Xuân Diệu are the trip. Go to Da Nang when that city is the trip. The coast road between them is 300 km.

faqs.q: What do the Kỳ Co and Cù Lao Xanh prices buy?
faqs.a: Kỳ Co is listed at 30,000–60,000 đồng, and Cù Lao Xanh at 200,000–350,000 đồng. Read the board before you pay. Eo Gió is a separate 25,000 đồng ticket, children under 0.9 m free.

faqs.q: Is the city still Quy Nhon?
faqs.a: Quy Nhơn is still described as the center of Bình Định, 6,039.56 km² and 1,500,000 people. A 22 Apr 2025 draft described a merged province named Gia Lai, with the administrative center at present-day Quy Nhơn, about 21,576 km² and more than 3.1 million people. Resolution 202/2025/QH15 is dated 12 June 2025.

faqs.q: When is the Nước Mặn festival?
faqs.a: In 2025 the public days were 27 Feb–1 Mar, lunar 30th of the first month through the 2nd of the second month, Ất Tỵ. The place is thôn An Hòa, xã Phước Quang, huyện Tuy Phước, inland from the city beach. It is national intangible heritage, recognized in 2022.

Tháp Bánh Ít is about 20 km away, 15,000 đồng, open 7:00–18:00. The Quang Trung museum is about 45 km northwest, 15,000 đồng, open 7:00–18:00. Trung Lương is listed as free and as 40,000 đồng including a shower, children under 1 m free. Xuân Diệu’s childhood house is at Gò Bồi, inland from the beach street. Quảng Ngãi and Sông Cầu are the coast on either side.

season.label: Eo Gió, lunar month 3–9
season.note: The climate line is an average of 27.4°C and 1,935 mm of rain. The calm window at Eo Gió is lunar month 3 through the end of lunar month 9. Stay away when the sea is rough. That window is the cove. The city beach is the swim in the center.
